evaluation.summary: 本轮需求（服务请求受理 + 持久站内通知）实际用到了 NocoBase3 的 Workflow、Notification、In-App、DB/Authorization、ServiceProvider、App config、Drive、App-Client 与 i18n 能力。逐一核对源码与 Skill 后：Workflow 的 define/condition.branch/执行记录、Notification→In-App 的持久收件箱与按用户隔离、DB Repository 的 policy 约束都有对应实现且被 Agent 按指引采用，需求映射基本成立。主要障碍是 Workflow 公开服务契约（仅 registerInstruction/trigger）比运行时窄，Agent 未用推荐的 trigger() 而是 cast 到 discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized/triggerRevision；此外 Workflow Artifact 磁盘必须落在 server 树内这一点在 Skill 中未直接说明。未查看任何截图，故不做视觉评审。

modules.name: Workflow DSL、触发、分支与执行记录
modules.scope: Workflow 源 DSL 编写、Condition 分支、业务触发入口与 workflowRuns/nodeRuns 持久化记录的本次使用。
modules.limitations: 只读取了源管理的触发路径与 condition/run 指令；未覆盖管理 HTTP API、调度触发、terminate、自定义指令和 Artifact 构建流水线。

requirements.need: 受理服务请求时通过现有 Workflow 登记受理、按 urgent 标记走普通/紧急分支并留下可查看的执行记录（B01、B03、R01）。
requirements.responsibility: 插件负责 DSL 与指令契约、Artifact 物化、执行生命周期与持久历史；应用负责工作流源码、触发时机、业务规则与幂等。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 defineWorkflow 绑定 WorkflowSourceAst，以节点数组表达顺序、ConditionInstruction.branch 表达分支，run 节点只做类型化执行；业务侧 resolve workflowServiceToken 并调用 trigger(workflowKey, input, options?)。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用用 RunInstruction + ConditionInstruction.branch 编写并成功运行 workflow.ts；但触发时未调用公开 trigger()，而是把服务 cast 成自定义 WorkflowRuntime，调用 discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized/triggerRevision。

requirements.need: 紧急与普通结果分支要能确定性选择，并从执行记录观察到实际走了哪一支（B03）。
requirements.responsibility: 插件负责条件求值、yes/no 分支派发以及每个节点的 nodeRun 记录。
requirements.recommendedUsage: ConditionInstruction.create({config:{expression}}).branch({yes,no})；节点 key 全局唯一，每个节点必须有不重复其标题的 description。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用用表达式 ===[var nodeResults.registerAcceptance.urgent,true] 配置 yes/no 两支，分别 recordUrgentResult / recordNormalResult。

requirements.need: 执行记录能看到步骤和最终结果，而不是直接写成功状态冒充 Workflow（R01）。
requirements.responsibility: 插件持久化 workflowRuns/nodeRuns（status、input/output、时间戳、eventKey 唯一）并通过管理视图暴露。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 不要在指引外直接编辑 materialized workflow 表；通过管理 API 或记录观察。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用的 run 节点只更新业务表状态，执行记录由插件写入；未观察到应用直接改工作流物化表。

requirementFit.reason: 插件与 Skill 直接覆盖 define/condition.branch/执行记录，业务需求最终达成；唯一折损是触发走的是公开契约之外的内部方法，而非指引推荐的 trigger()。

usability.reason: 公开 WorkflowServiceContract 只暴露 registerInstruction/trigger，而应用需要的 discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized/triggerRevision 只能经 internalWorkflowServiceToken 或 cast 取得，SKILL 顶层又提示不要绕过内部实现，入口一致性偏弱。

agentFriendliness.reason: SKILL 与 dsl-authoring 明确写出 trigger 的 eventKey/异步/skipped 语义、分支契约和必填 description，Agent 可据此正确使用；但对“预检/指定 revision”与公开 trigger 的对应关系说明不足。

design.reason: 插件把 DSL/指令/生命周期与应用触发的边界分得清楚，ConditionInstruction 用静态 branches/branching 声明分支契约，run 节点与服务解析器保持只读，抽象边界合理。

reliability.reason: 实现中 trigger 会先按 current 行解析并在加载前 ensureMaterialized(hash)，ConditionInstruction 对表达式做布尔校验后按 yes/no 派发并持久化 nodeRun，兑现了公开约定。

modules.name: 持久站内通知投递与收件箱
modules.scope: 通知服务的 send 契约与幂等、In-App 频道/Provider 到持久收件箱的投递、按用户的读取/已读/删除隔离。
modules.limitations: 未运行应用，也未覆盖邮件/IM 渠道、realtime 断线重连、read-all 与投递重试矩阵；未读取 notification providers 插件实现。

requirements.need: 受理后向负责人发送一条持久站内消息，能对应到业务请求，而不是 toast 或自建消息表（B02、R02）。
requirements.responsibility: Notification 插件负责渠道派发、消息校验与幂等；In-App 插件负责入库持久化与收件人存在性校验；应用负责收件人与业务关联。
requirements.recommendedUsage: send({ idempotencyKey, source:{type,referenceId}, messages:{ inbox:{ to, title, body, target:{type:'route',path} } } })，并配置 channels.inbox.provider='in-app'。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用调用 notification.send，带 idempotencyKey service-request-accepted:<id>、source service-request、messages.inbox.to=assigneeId、target route /service-requests/<id>，与推荐写法一致。

requirements.need: 非收件人看不到这两条个人消息（B04、R03）。
requirements.responsibility: In-App 插件负责按用户隔离的落库查询、未认证 401 与 CSRF；应用不自行实现消息表。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 列表/未读数/变更都以会话用户为范围；投递前做 recipientExists 校验，不存在则不可重试失败且不落库。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用复用插件收件箱与路由，未新建消息表；store 的 list/countUnread/update 均以 userId 过滤，Provider 用用户管理服务做 recipientExists。

requirements.need: 标记已读后刷新仍为已读（B02）。
requirements.responsibility: In-App 插件持久化 readAt 并以 HTTP 状态为权威，realtime 仅作失效通知。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 变更走 read/unread/delete 接口（带 CSRF），UI 收到 inbox.changed 后重新拉取 HTTP 状态。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用使用插件收件箱组件与接口；store.update 对 read/unread/delete 均以 id+userId 为条件写入 readAt。

requirementFit.reason: 投递、持久化、按用户隔离、已读持久化与跳转目标均有直接实现，应用使用了与推荐完全一致的 send 形状，需求覆盖完整。

usability.reason: notificationServiceToken + messages 渠道映射 + channels.inbox.provider 即可完成接入；Skill 明确要求先注册核心插件再注册 in-app 插件，默认行为清晰。

agentFriendliness.reason: 两个 Skill 给出可直接照抄的 send 片段、target 规则、收件人校验要求和按序诊断清单，Agent 能定位渠道/收件人/持久化问题。

design.reason: 渠道/Provider 注册表把传输与持久化解耦，In-App 用 user-scoped store + realtime 失效事件，扩展点和所有权边界明确。

reliability.reason: manager.send 在持久化前校验消息与 source 并用 requestFingerprint 去重；store 的查询与更新都以 userId 收窄；router 中间件未认证返回 401 且变更需 CSRF。

modules.name: 应用装配：Provider、config 与磁盘
modules.scope: 应用服务 token/Provider 注册与生命周期、按 namespace 的 config 工厂、Workflow Artifact 所需磁盘配置。
modules.limitations: 未覆盖 client 侧 service provider、队列/定时任务与多连接数据库配置；未读取 drive 的磁盘实现，仅核对了公开配置类型。

requirements.need: 把业务 service（服务请求读写、触发 Workflow）以可解析 token 注入应用容器，并声明 workflow/notification/drive 配置（R01）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责容器/provider 生命周期与 config 工厂契约；应用负责绑定实现与配置值。
requirements.recommendedUsage: ServiceProvider 子类在 register() 用 container.singleton 绑定 token、在 boot() 做依赖其它服务的注册；每个 config namespace 用 defineAppConfig 工厂。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 providers/index 注册 ServiceRequestProvider，register() 绑定 serviceRequestServiceToken，boot() 向 authorization 注册 collection/pages；server/config/* 用 defineAppConfig 返回 workflow/notification/drive 配置。

requirements.need: Workflow 物化后的 run 模块能被 Node import() 解析到 @nocobase/* 依赖，因此 Artifact 磁盘位置要可控。
requirements.responsibility: drive 负责磁盘声明；workflow 插件负责 Artifact 目录约定；应用负责选择/新增磁盘。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 AppDriveConfig.disks 中声明所需磁盘并让 workflow.artifactDisk 指向它，使 Artifact 位于可解析依赖的目录。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用新增 fs 磁盘 workflowArtifacts 并把 location 指向 paths.server()，避免默认 local(storage) 被迁移后 run 模块无法解析依赖。

requirementFit.reason: 容器/Provider 生命周期与 defineAppConfig 契约足以完成 service 注入与配置装配，磁盘契约也支持 Artifact 落位；Artifact 磁盘位置需要应用自行推断。

usability.reason: provider register()/boot() 与 defineAppConfig 步骤简单，container.resolve 在缺 token 时给出清晰错误并检测循环依赖；磁盘与 Artifact 目录的匹配规则未集中说明。

agentFriendliness.reason: services-and-jobs 给出完整 provider 示例、token 身份规则与生命周期表，Agent 能照做；Artifact 磁盘位置的提示散落在 workflow 与 drive 两处，需自行拼合。

design.reason: token 即身份、按 namespace 拆配置、Provider 生命周期分层，均是稳定的扩展抽象；磁盘与应用配置通过 drive 契约解耦。

reliability.reason: container 实现缓存 singleton 结果、对创建失败缓存 error、并检测并阻止循环依赖，兑现了生命周期与解析语义。

modules.name: 数据访问、迁移与授权
modules.scope: 业务表迁移与持久化、按请求作用域的 Repository policy 约束、collection/page 授权注册与权限集配置。
modules.limitations: 未执行迁移或数据库，未覆盖多作用域、事务、字段级与关系级授权的完整矩阵；未读取 authorization 的实现代码（仅公开契约与 Skill）。

requirements.need: 持久保存服务请求表并通过受授权路由读写，消息收件人范围也要受限（B01、B04、R03）。
requirements.responsibility: db 负责 Repository/迁移/policy 执行；authorization 插件负责作用域求值与授权注册；应用负责表结构与业务动作映射。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 迁移建表；业务路由解析 authorizationToken，用 db.policyFor/authorizeRepository 绑定业务动作，并把 conditions.database policy 通过 repository.withPolicy 施加到读写；显式 authz.db.collections.add 注册 collection。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 migration 创建 serviceRequests；provider boot 调 authz.db.collections.add 与 pages.add；路由用 authorizationToken + authorization.db.policyFor + defineApiRoutes；repository.withPolicy 绑定行范围。

requirements.need: 非收件人无法读取他人消息，授权边界要有真实服务调用证据（B04）。
requirements.responsibility: authorization 插件执行 deny-by-default 与作用域策略；应用声明并配置业务权限集。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 未注册的 collection 默认拒绝；业务权限集用 defineDatabasePermission/defineAuthorizationResource 组合，配置由 seed 初始化并可后台编辑。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用用 seed 建 service-request-user 权限集与默认访问，provider 注册 collection/pages，路由按 policyFor 的行范围读。

requirementFit.reason: db policy 与 authorization 服务覆盖了行范围读写与 deny-by-default 注册，应用按推荐方式用 withPolicy/policyFor，需求映射成立。

usability.reason: withPolicy 会拒绝二次绑定并要求从连接/Manager 重新取 Repository，类型上还需 cast 才能恢复记录类型；Skill 解释了边界但接入步骤偏重。

agentFriendliness.reason: authorization SKILL 给出台阶式实现顺序和明确的 enforcement 规则（collections.add、policyFor 不定义业务边界等），Agent 可据此判定接入正确性。

design.reason: Repository policy 把读/写/创建/删除边界显式化，collection 注册与授权分离，避免把授权决策混进迁移代码。

reliability.reason: withPolicy 规范化并冻结 policy，且拒绝覆盖已绑定的 policy 以防扩大权限；Policy 类型强制显式声明 scope 与 fields。

modules.name: 客户端页面、路由与 i18n
modules.scope: URL 可寻址的列表/详情路由与页面数据访问、服务端出境文本的按收件人语言翻译。
modules.limitations: 未在浏览器中查看页面或截图，故不评价样式一致性；未读取前端渲染/覆盖组件的完整实现，仅核对公开导出与路由契约。

requirements.need: 提供请求列表/详情页，并让通知的 Open 链接能跳到对应请求（B01、B02）。
requirements.responsibility: app-client 负责路由契约、页面鉴权与 API 客户端组合；应用负责页面组件与路由表。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineAppRoutes 声明 path/componentLoader/auth/authz，页面通过 useApiClient 发请求并处理 loading/error。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用用 defineAppRoutes 声明 service-requests 列表与 :serviceRequestId 子路由，detail 页用 useApiClient 拉取记录与负责人并做 loading/404/403 状态。

requirements.need: 站内消息与服务端文案按收件人语言输出，并保持中英文一致（R02）。
requirements.responsibility: i18n 负责运行时、命名空间与按 locale 的翻译；应用负责 locale 文件与 key。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 出境内容（通知/邮件/后台任务）显式解析收件人 locale、ensureLocaleLoaded 后用 getFixedT(APP_NS, locale)；客户端用 useTranslation/useLocale，locale 文件列表决定可选语言。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 notify 路径 resolveLocale→ensureLocaleLoaded→getFixedT(APP_NS, locale) 生成标题与正文；提供 en-US/zh-CN 客户端与服务端 locale。

requirementFit.reason: 路由与 API 客户端支撑列表/详情与通知跳转，i18n 运行时支撑按收件人语言的持久消息文案，需求得到直接支持。

usability.reason: defineAppRoutes/useApiClient 入口小且类型化；getFixedT 要求出境文本显式传 locale，Skill 明确说明了这一前提，接入成本低。

agentFriendliness.reason: i18n.md 清楚区分客户端文案与服务端出境文案、列出 locale 文件决定语言的规则，Agent 能正确放置翻译 key。

design.reason: 路由定义冻结、单一 i18n 运行时以命名空间链回退，公开抽象稳定且不要求应用重复实现基座。

reliability.reason: defineAppRoutes 冻结路由与导航、getFixedT 限定 locale 并按命名空间链回退，实现与文档描述一致。

findings.title: Workflow 条件分支与执行记录直接支撑可核查的受理流程
findings.detail: ConditionInstruction 对表达式做布尔校验后按 yes/no 派发并把 nodeRun 持久化，workflowRuns 记录 status/input/output、eventKey 唯一且 nodeRuns 级联；应用用该能力表达普通/紧急两种结果，未自建流程状态机。
findings.impact: 验收 B03/R01 要求的“从执行与业务结果确认走了紧急分支”有框架级持久记录作为依据，无需应用自行伪造执行历史。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持 condition/nodeRun 契约稳定，并在 Skill 中继续强调用记录而非直接写业务状态来证明分支。

findings.title: 应用以 cast 绕过 Workflow 公开 trigger() 契约
findings.detail: 应用把 workflowServiceToken 解析结果 cast 为自定义 WorkflowRuntime，调用 discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized/triggerRevision；而公开契约只承诺 registerInstruction/trigger，Skill 也明确建议业务触发使用 trigger() 并提示不要绕过插件内部。trigger() 本身会解析 current 版本、物化 hash 并支持 force/eventKey，足以覆盖该场景。
findings.impact: 应用与插件内部方法耦合，插件升级改变内部签名时会静默或类型失配；同时绕过了 Skill 推荐的 skipped/eventKey 语义。
findings.suggestedChange: 改用 workflowServiceToken.trigger(SERVICE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_KEY, input, { force:true, waitForCompletion:true, eventKey })；若确需内部方法，改为显式解析插件导出的 internalWorkflowServiceToken 而非 cast。

findings.title: Notification 幂等与 In-App 持久收件箱满足“持久、可跳转、按人隔离”
findings.detail: manager.send 在落库前校验消息并基于 requestFingerprint 去重，In-App Provider 在投递前做 recipientExists，store 以 userId 收窄 list/countUnread/update，router 未认证返回 401 且写操作需 CSRF。
findings.impact: 验收 B02/B04/R02/R03 要求的持久消息、跳转与收件人范围都有真实实现支撑，应用无需自建消息表或用 toast 冒充。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持 recipientExists 与 user-scoped 查询作为默认，不提供宽松回退；继续在 Skill 中要求以 HTTP 状态为权威。

findings.title: Workflow Artifact 磁盘位置约束未在 Skill 中集中说明
findings.detail: 物化后的 run 模块由 Node import() 加载，其裸依赖需能从 Artifact 目录解析；若 artifactDisk 指向默认 local(storage) 且 storage 被迁移到应用之外，run 模块将无法解析 @nocobase/*。应用为此新增了位于 server 树内的 workflowArtifacts 磁盘，但 workflow 相关 Skill 仅在 execution-diagnostics 中以一句“artifact 是否在配置的私有磁盘上”提及，未说明落位与依赖解析的因果关系。
findings.impact: Agent 需要自行推断磁盘约束，容易在部署迁移后遇到难定位的 run 模块加载失败。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 workflow 配置/装配指引中补充：artifactDisk 必须位于能解析 run 模块依赖的目录（通常是编译后的 server 树），并给出 drive 磁盘配置示例。

evidence.excerpt:
# Invoke and Manage

- Business code resolves `workflowServiceToken` and calls `trigger(workflowKey, input, options?)`. The public service contract does not expose a management `run()` method or a generic public HTTP trigger endpoint.
- Use the authenticated management API for listing and inspecting definitions, enablement, parameter overrides, and authorized manual execution of a selected definition revision. A manual run may target a historical or disabled revision without changing its enablement.
- When source is available, use its directory key and `inputSchema` as the contract for new business-trigger code. In a deployed environment where only the management API is available, use runtime records for inspection and manual management; do not infer a new business trigger contract from a title or database id.
- `trigger()` returns either `skipped` with no event key or `accepted` with an event key after synchronous validation and scheduling succeed. Execution is asynchronous. Resolve the run by event key, and account for a concurrent duplicate call that can return the shared accepted identity before the first call finishes creating the run.
- An `eventKey` is optional and generated when omitted. Reuse the same stable key only when resubmitting the same business event whose acceptance is unknown; an existing run is deduplicated rather than re-executed. The public contract does not rerun a confirmed failed run by event key.

evidence.observation: .branch({yes,no}) 附着嵌套块并在父节点后继继续；节点/branch key 必须全局唯一且匹配标识符规则；每个节点（含嵌套分支与自定义指令）必须有非空、描述真实逻辑的 description。
evidence.excerpt:
- `.branch({ yes: [...], no: [...] })` attaches nested blocks to a branching node. Branch blocks return to the parent and then continue at the parent's next sibling.
- Branch map order has no semantics; keys are normalized in stable order. Node array order is semantic and must not be reordered.
- There is no `.next()`, `.goto()`, `.join()`, `.start()`, callback builder, or arbitrary cycle.
- Every node key across the complete workflow, including all branches, must be globally unique and match `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`.
- Node and branch keys cannot be `__proto__`, `prototype`, or `constructor`.
- Keep node keys stable across revisions. Titles/descriptions may change; keys connect history, diagnostics, and result references.
- Only call `.branch()` on a branching node, and only use branch names declared by that instruction contract.

Every node source has `key`, optional `title`, `description`, required `config`, and optional `result`. When authoring or editing workflow orchestration, you must provide a non-empty, non-whitespace `description` for every node, including all nested branch nodes and custom Instructions. Fill missing descriptions in the workflow being edited and update descriptions whenever node logic changes. This is a mandatory authoring rule even though the DSL schema currently permits omission; a passing checker does not replace this review.

evidence.excerpt:
## Final delivery validation

The database Provider checks the recipient through Authentication’s user administration service immediately before writing the inbox item. A missing user returns a non-retryable `recipient` failure and creates no inbox item or realtime event. A lookup failure remains a retryable storage failure. Custom hosts calling `createDatabaseProviderDefinition` must supply `recipientExists(userId)` backed by their authoritative user directory; do not use a permissive fallback.

## HTTP and realtime behavior

The authenticated inbox API is rooted at `notifications/in-app` relative to the injected `ApiClient` API base. Reads include list and unread-count. Writes include read/unread/delete and read-all, each preceded by an authenticated CSRF-token request.

For a custom host, register the exported `IN_APP_NOTIFICATION_NAMESPACE` and `inAppNotificationServerLocales` with its `I18nRuntime`, initialize the runtime, then mount its request i18n middleware before the inbox router. Notification-owned failures return a stable `error.code/message/ns/key/params` envelope; branch on `code`, display `message`, and use `ns`, `key`, and `params` only when the Client needs to retranslate it. Authentication middleware retains its owning plugin's error contract.

The WebSocket topic is user-scoped by the Server. An `inbox.changed` event does not carry authoritative inbox contents; it tells the UI to refetch HTTP state. The UI also refetches when the realtime connection opens so events missed during disconnection are recovered. Window focus is a fallback invalidation.

When an application configures `api.baseURL` or `api.realtimeURL`, both transports must use those injected client settings. Never derive the HTTP endpoint from `window.location`, a Portal base, or the WebSocket URL.

evidence.excerpt:
1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable resource, page and scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable data permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing actions with `defineAuthorizationResource`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every table touched by a workflow.
3. Register collections, pages, flat resource groups, resources and record-access strategies in the owning provider. Resolve dependencies at boot and release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, retain `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.db.authorizeRepository` to map methods to business actions; it reuses or initializes the request authorization scope. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple scopes or custom responses, use a custom handler with `authz.middleware()`, call the request scope's `authorize()` once and apply every returned table policy using `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow the selection criteria and complete code in [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Add page authorization and `useCan` for action visibility. Obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending/error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page/action grants, selected scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; do not assume editing a seed updates a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.
7. Verify denied as well as allowed requests through the production route factory and actual database policies. Then verify the UI with ordinary users and inherited memberships.

## Enforcement rules

- Register collections explicitly with `authz.db.collections.add({ name, title, actions? })`. Metadata comes from DB; registration grants nothing. Unregistered collections are denied even to unrestricted users.
- Business groups compose database capabilities; administration groups compose settings/system capabilities. Page grants are separate. Page visibility never authorizes a server endpoint.
- `can` is for feature visibility. `require`/`guard` require unconditional permission and reject conditional decisions. Composed business endpoints use `authorize`, reject denial/missing policies, and consume `conditions.database` without resolving aggregate grants again.
- For simple business CRUD, keep the original Repository route definition and use `db.authorizeRepository` to bind each method to its business action. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md). Multi-scope actions and workflow transitions require custom handlers. `db.policyFor` aggregates collection grants; it does not define a business-action boundary.
- Scope every read and write in the workflow, including parent lookups. Keep multi-record writes transactional and include expected business state in mutation predicates. Authorization does not validate a quote's amount or its workflow transition.

evidence.excerpt:
Frontend copy — the locale files under `client/locales/`, translating in components, key naming, date and number formatting, rewording a plugin's text and the language control — is in [frontend copy and translations](frontend/references/i18n.md). This page covers the text the server translates, which languages the application offers, the default language, and what an untranslated key falls back to.

## Server-side text

API error messages, notifications and mail need translation too. The server translates them from `server/locales/`: `en-US.ts` states the wording and exports `AppServerResource`, and every other server locale is annotated with that type, so a key missing from one is a compile error. The template's server locales start empty — the server text that exists belongs to plugins — so add keys when the application's own endpoints start producing text. Name them by the same rules as client keys.

- The server resolves a request's language from the session's stored choice, then `Accept-Language`, then `i18n.defaultLocale`.
- Outbound content follows its recipient: mail, notifications and background work translate into the recipient's language, not the language of whoever triggered the work. A background job has no request to inherit a language from — resolve the recipient's locale explicitly and load it before translating. The `nocobase-app-plugin-i18n` Skill shows how server code translates.
